name: Enable-Actual
description: Enable Actual imports transactions from European banks into Actual Budget through Enable Banking (official PSD2 APIs, free for personal use, read-only access to your accounts). A web UI handles setup, account mapping, import schedules and history, with optional ntfy notifications. Image tag: the Actual client bundled in the image must be the same version as your Actual Budget server or newer. Set the tag to your Actual server version, e.g. 2manyvcos/enable-actual:actual26.10.0 for Actual 26.10.0, and change it each time you update Actual. latest always ships the newest Actual client: only keep it if your Actual server is always up to date. First launch: set Public URL to the exact address you open the UI with (e.g. https://192.168.1.10:3000), since the UI calls the API through it. Open that address and follow the setup: Enable Banking application (redirect URL: PUBLIC_URL/enablebanking/callback), Actual Budget server (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5006), account mapping and schedule. HTTPS is required by Enable Banking: SSL is on by default with a self-signed certificate (expect a browser warning). There is no built-in authentication: never expose the port to the internet, use a reverse proxy with authentication if you need remote access.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Settings, import history and Actual cache (owner 1001:1001)

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Address you open the UI with, e.g. https://192.168.1.10:3000 (also the Enable Banking redirect base)

variables.name: SSL_ENABLED
variables.description: Serve HTTPS with a self-signed certificate (false behind a reverse proxy that handles HTTPS)

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Internal listen port (must match WebUI Port container port)

variables.name: SSL_CERTIFICATE_FILE
variables.description: Your own certificate, path inside the container (e.g. /data/cert.pem); set with SSL_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE

variables.name: SSL_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
variables.description: Private key of your own certificate, path inside the container (e.g. /data/key.pem)

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log level: none, info or debug

variables.name: HISTORY_LENGTH
variables.description: Number of import history entries kept
